events.event: English-speaking applicant submits a complete simple case during staffed hours; status must distinguish submission from determination.
Applicant needing oral explanation in an unsupported language arrives at 16:30; the assisted slot is full and the interface was abandoned.
An overnight software fault closes 14 ambiguous cases as ineligible; the status notice appears final. Interpretation remains unavailable overnight and no extra staff arrive.
